profile.summary: The Berkeley School of Education (formerly the Graduate School of Education) is the education school of the University of California, Berkeley, a public university. It offers graduate degrees, teaching credential programs and educational leadership programs, and does research on teaching and learning. It works with Bay Area school districts, including Oakland Unified, on teacher preparation and professional learning.
